question: What preparatory breath practice must accompany the performance of yogic postures?
premises: A threefold breath-control is to be performed
Yogic postures are to be undertaken
The breath-control precedes or accompanies the postures
inference: Proper practice of postures requires first performing a threefold breath-control.
plain_english: Having performed the threefold breath-control, one should then practice the postures.
